article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Rhyjon Blackwell scored 13 points as Marist beat Niagara 58-46 on Sunday. Blackwell shot 3 of 7 from the field and 6 for 6 from the line for the Red Foxes (15-7, 9-4 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Elijah Lewis added 10 points while finishing 4 of 10 from the floor and had six rebounds. Justin Hawkins finished with 14 points for the Purple Eagles (5-17, 2-10). Trenton Walters added 10 points and four assists for Niagara. Vice Zanki also recorded seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
